technical-data.invention-title: A PIECE OF FURNITURE WITH EXTRACTABLE ELEMENTS AND ADJUSTABLE SUPPORTS FOR ORDERLY CONTAINING SHOES, SLIPPERS AND SIMILAR
MEUBLE AVEC ELEMENTS EXTRACTIBLES ET SUPPORTS REGLABLES POUR RANGER DES CHAUSSURES, DES PANTOUFLES, ET D'AUTRES ACCESSOIRES SIMILAIRES

abstract.p: A piece of furniture with extractable elements and adjustable supports for orderly containing shoes, slippers and similar, consisting of a covering element (1), open in correspondence of one of its narrow lateral faces (2), from which an internal means (3) for housing shoes and similar is taken out, mounted on small wheels (4) or other, which in turn is provided with a plurality of shelves (6) comprising supporting elements for a plurality of shoes, placed in vertical position, that may be adjusted in different positions.

L'invention concerne un meuble pourvu d'éléments extractibles et de supports réglables, ce meuble permettant de ranger des chaussures, des pantoufles, et d'autres accessoires similaires. Ce meuble comprend un élément couvrant (1) dont l'un (2) des cotés latéraux étroits est ouvert, ce qui permet de dévoiler une structure support (3) destinée à loger des chaussures et d'autres accessoires similaires. Cette structure, qui est montée sur des roulettes (4) ou des dispositifs identiques, est pourvue de plusieurs étagères (6) comprenant des éléments supports pour plusieurs paires de chaussures, lesquelles peuvent être placées verticalement ou dans différentes positions.

description.p: "A PIECE OF FURNITURE WITH EXTRACTABLE ELEMENTS AND ADJUSTABLE SUPPORTS FOR ORDERLY CONTAINING SHOES, SLIPPERS AND SI MILAR"
The present invention concerns a piece of furniture with extractable elements and adjustable supports for orderly containing shoes, slippers and similar.

The household problem is well known to orderly keep all the shoes of the hole family, which at present is solved by means of shoe-cupboard with a plurality of shelves which, moreover, always are encumbersome of large surfaces of walls, even if of reduced thickness.

It is the aim of the present invention to exploit possible free spaces in the household, e.g. between cupboards or other furniture and the walls, even if only of 1 5 cm and for unimportant depths, which at present are completely unused.

The aim set forth is reached by means of the piece of furniture according to the present invention, which consists of a covering element, open in correspondence of one of its narrow lateral faces, from which an interal means for housing shoes and similar is taken out, mounted on small wheels or other, which in turn is provided with a
plurality of shelves comprising supporting elements for a plurality of shoes, that may be adjusted in different positions, so that once the piece of furniture has been inserted into a space of reduced thickness - even of tens of centimeters - and depths different according to the situations, said piece of furniture is not of any encumbrance while, at the moment of use, the internal containing element is taken out by means of a handle or similar, showing the shoes orderly stored therein.

The advantages deriving from the present invention are evident: infact, a plurality of shoe containers may be arranged in different points of the house, which until now have been unused, showing only the narrow extraction face while, following to the motion on the small wheels, the whole extension of the piece of furniture may be shown for the choice of many pairs of shoes and similar, of any shape an dimension.
The present invention will be described more in detail hereinbelow relating to the enclosed drawings in which some embodiments are shown.

Figure 1 shows an axonometric view of a piece of furniture with extractable elements and adjustable supports for orderly containing shoes,
slippers and similar, with the internal element pulled out of the container. Figure 2 shows a lateral view of the piece of furniture according to the present invention. Figure 3 shows a detail of a shoes' support, provided with movable guides and blades. Figure 4 shows a detail of the guide for the sliding of the movable blades. Figure 5 shows a plant view of the particular motion of the drawers of minimum encumbrance. Figure 6 shows a movable hinge with a pin for said drawers. Figure 7 shows an axonometric view of a variant of the piece of furniture with a low structure, with the carriage pulled out. Figure 8 shows a lateral view of the variant according to figure 7. Figure 9 shows the motion of the drawers of the latter variant.
The enclosed figures show a piece of furniture with extractable elements and adjustable supports for orderly containing shoes, slippers and similar, mainly consisting of:

- a covering structure 1 with a preferably parallelepiped shape, open along the rectangular faces 2, and with the
prefered thickness of 1 5-20 cm so that it may be placed in small spaces;

- a carriage structure 3, movable on wheels 4, consisting of two uprights 5, 5' of dimensions corresponding to said faces 2 of said structure 1 , so that they fit perfectly, and comprising a plurality of shelves 6 with a nonskid rubber plane, and with lateral guides 7 for the correct sliding of the supporting blades 8 which may be moved, in particular in vertical sense, for getting suitable to the support of the different kinds of shoes S, of different dimensions, which in this way take much less space than when they are placed in plane position;
- an articulation 9 for the motion of said blades 8 on the sliding guides 7;
- two drawers 10, opposed in the lower end part of said carriage 3, with angular opening on movable hinges 1 1 , with a standstill tongue 1 2 pin.

In the variant of the present invention shown in figures 7, 8 and 9, only one shelf 6 is provided with a double housing with guides 7 for few shoes and a consequent low total height, for the solution of particular space problems.

In such a case, the drawers 10' are arranged side by side with opposed angular pulling out.
According to the present invention, the safe insertion of the carriage 3 in the structure 1 is faciltated with suitable shapings of the uprights 5, 5' and of said structure 1 .

claim.claim-text: A piece of furniture with extractable elements and adjustable supports for orderly containing shoes, slippers and similar, characterized in:
- a covering structure (1 ) with a preferably parallelepiped shape, open along the rectangular faces (2), and with the prefered thickness of 1 5-20 cm so that it may be placed in small spaces;

- a carriage structure (3), movable on wheels ( 4 ) , consisting of two uprights (5, 5') of dimensions corresponding to said faces (2) of said structure (1 ), so that they fit perfectly, and comprising a plurality of shelves
(6) with a nonskid rubber plane, and with lateral guides

(7) for the correct sliding of the supporting blades (8) which may be moved, in particular in vertical sense, for getting suitable to the support of the different kinds of shoes (S), of different dimensions, which in this way take much less space than when they are placed in plane position;
- an articulation (9) for the motion of said blades (8) on the sliding guides (7);
- two drawers (10), opposed in the lower end part of said carriage (3), with angular opening on movable hinges (1 1 ), with a standstill tongue (12) pin.

2. A piece of furniture according to claim 1 , characterized in the presence of one single shelf (6) with double housing and with guides (7) for few shows and consequently with a low total height, for the solution of particular space problems.
3. A piece of furniture according to claim 1 , characterized in the presence of drawers (10') arranged side by side with opposed angular pulling out.
4. A piece of furniture according to claim 1 , characterized in suitable shapings of uprights (5, 5') and of the structure for the safe insertion of the carriage (3).
